title: Growth that lasts

predict.q: AD and LRAS both shift right by the same amount (20). What happens to real output and the price level in the long run?

options.s: Real output rises by 20; the price level is unchanged
options.fb: LRAS sets output at 520; AD rose by as much, so there is no pressure on prices: price level 100.

options.s: Real output is unchanged; the price level rises
options.fb: That is AD shifting alone. Here LRAS moved too, so capacity rose by 20.

options.s: Real output rises by 20; the price level falls
options.fb: That is LRAS shifting alone. AD rose by the same amount, so there is no pressure on prices either way.

options.s: Real output rises by 40; the price level rises
options.fb: Output can only reach the new LRAS: 520. The shifts are the same size, so they do not add up to 40.

task: Move the AD slider and the LRAS slider, separately and together, and watch real output and the price level.

target.do: Set both sliders to 20, then press Check.

takeaway: In the long run, with a vertical LRAS, only LRAS sets output. AD alone raises the price level; growth without inflation needs AD and LRAS to grow together.
